The Police-Inspector of Kempegowda nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused NO.1 to 5 for the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 506(B), 504 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec. 3 & 4 of D.P. Act.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Rakshitha R..
The gist of the prosecution case is that the Accused No.1 got married with CW-1 on 22-11-2019.
As per Accused demand, the parents of CW-1 had  3  C.C.No.29206/2021 given gold chain, finger ring and Titan watch, suit to Accused No.1.
After the marriage, while residing with the Accused No.1 to 5 demanded gold jewels and additional dowry from parents of CW-1.
At that time, after marriage of one month, accused made CW-1 to leave the job and harassed her in demand of Rs. One lakh and gold bracelet.

Based on the information of Smt.Rakshitha R., a case in Cr.No.40/2021 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.SI of Kempegowda nagara P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused caused physical and mental  cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry abused  and threatened her and thereby accused have  committed the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 506(B),
 504 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec. 3 & 4 of D.P. Act.?
 2) what order?
 5  C.C.No.29206/2021  8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 to Ex
. P3 documents
. Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex . P.2
is the spot panchanama.
Ex.P.3 is the Further Statement of PW-1.
10. CW-1 was examined as PW-1.

She in her examination-in- chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 22-11-2019 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not abuse her and did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never abused her.

PW-1 deposed that there Rakshitha R vs Srinivas on 6 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176269063/
4 was petty quarrel between her and accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1  6  C.C.No.29206/2021 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.
12. POINT No.2:-
